subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: Should direct Gemini text-block `textSignature` values be persisted and replayed as `thoughtSignature`, or should OpenClaw drop/store them outside normal session replay to prevent context bloat?
rationale: Current source intentionally preserves and replays valid same-route Gemini signatures, while the issue asks to stop retaining or re-sending them; that is a provider compatibility and session-retention contract choice.

options.title: Design a bounded Gemini signature policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose which Gemini signatures are required, then implement the narrow retention/replay rule with regression coverage.

options.title: Drop text-block signatures from replay
options.body: Treat text-block signatures as nonessential bloat and strip or externalize them while preserving tool-call signatures only where current Gemini models require them.

options.title: Keep current replay behavior
options.body: Accept the context-cost risk and close only after documenting why Gemini requires replaying these signatures.

recommendation.title: Design a bounded Gemini signature policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose which Gemini signatures are required, then implement the narrow retention/replay rule with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent transport validation PR is closest to the remaining signature-forwarding contract.
